body:
Hello,

We were charged twice for invoice INV-54012 ($1,240.00) on September 17. Please refund the duplicate.

Marcus Chen
Operations Manager, Brightpath Logistics

Hi Marcus, the duplicate September charge has been refunded (reference RF-87002). Sorry about that!

Rita

Is there a way to export all shipments from Q3 to a spreadsheet?

Olivia Grant
Hi Olivia, yes: Reports > Shipments, pick the date range and click Export CSV.

Hi,

It happened again: invoice INV-55120 ($1,240.00) was charged twice on October 26. Can you refund the second charge?

Marcus Chen
Operations Manager, Brightpath Logistics
Confirmed duplicate capture in Stripe. Sent to billing for refund; waiting on their confirmation before replying.

We're onboarding two new dispatchers next week. Please add two seats to our plan.

Marcus Chen
Operations Manager, Brightpath Logistics

Hi, I see two identical charges on our practice card this month. Could you check?

Dr. Marcus Cheng
Cheng Family Dental
Hi Dr. Cheng, one of those is a pre-authorization that will drop off in a few days. We're double-checking with billing and will get back to you.
